title: Documents
intro: Keep your certificates in one place. We’ll remind you before anything runs out, and you can send them to an organiser in one go.
loadFailed: Your documents couldn’t be loaded. Please try again.

counts.dueSoon: {count, plural, one {# due soon} other {# due soon}}
counts.upToDate: {count, plural, one {# up to date} other {# up to date}}

line.expiresIn: Expires {date} · {days, plural, one {in # day} other {in # days}}
line.reviewByIn: Review by {date} · {days, plural, one {in # day} other {in # days}}

upload.title: Add a document
upload.intro: Take a photo of it, or choose a photo or a file.
upload.accepted: PDF, JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP, up to 20 MB.
upload.tooBig: That file is over 20 MB. Please choose a smaller one.
upload.wrongType: That file type isn’t accepted. Please use a PDF, JPEG, PNG, HEIC or WebP file.
upload.failed: The upload didn’t work. Please try again.

check.title: Check the details
check.aiBanner: We read this from your document. Please check it’s right before saving.
check.coverHint: Optional. The amount the policy covers.
check.footer: The previous certificate is kept as history. Your files are private: only you, and organisers you send them to, can see them.
check.needType: Choose the document, or name it.
check.badDates: The expiry date can’t be before the issue date.

warnings.notRead: We couldn’t read this document. Please fill in the details yourself.
warnings.expired: This expired on {date}. You can still save it, but organisers will see that it has expired.
warnings.expiresSoon: {days, plural, =0 {This expires today. We’ll remind you every week until it’s renewed.} one {This expires in # day. We’ll remind you 4 weeks before, 1 week before and on the day.} other {This expires in # days. We’ll remind you 4 weeks before, 1 week before and on the day.}}
warnings.nameMismatch: The name on it, “{name}”, doesn’t look like your business name. Please check it’s the right document.

view.noPreview: This file can’t be shown here. Open it or download it instead.
view.deleteConfirm: Delete this document and its earlier versions? The files are removed, and it comes off any link you’ve sent.

send.title: Send to organiser
send.intro: They get an email with a link to view or download everything.
send.emailHint: Up to 5 addresses, separated by commas.
send.messagePlaceholder: Hi, here are our documents for the market.
send.footer: If you renew a certificate, the organiser’s link shows the new one automatically. You’ll see when they open it.
send.emailTooMany: You can send to up to 5 addresses at once.
send.untilRange: Choose a date from tomorrow up to 90 days from today.

sent.title: Sent
sent.opened: Opened {date} · {count, plural, one {# view} other {# views}}
sent.turnOffConfirm: Turn off this link? The organiser won’t be able to open it any more.

page.title: Documents from {truck}
page.intro: {truck} has shared these documents with you.
page.none: There are no documents on this link at the moment.
page.expiredBody: This link has expired, ask {truck} to send it again.
page.expiredBodyUnknown: This link has expired. Please ask the business that sent it to send it again.

email.shareIntro: {truck} has shared these documents with you.
email.shareUntil: The link works until {date}. If it has expired, ask {truck} to send it again.
email.shareReply: Reply to this email to contact {truck}.
email.reminderSubject: {count, plural, one {A document needs renewing} other {# documents need renewing}}
email.reminderIn: {document} expires on {date} ({days, plural, one {in # day} other {in # days}})
email.reminderFooter: We remind you 4 weeks before, 1 week before and on the day, then every week until it’s renewed.
